opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary Target shopping promotion from Gift Card Granny: the speaker identifies herself as being on its marketing team and offers ways to save at Target. She expressly explains that viewers can "purchase a Gift Card Granny Target gift card and earn 2% in cash back rewards," while also stating that the cards can be used "to purchase all of your household needs." The displayed Buy a Target Gift Card page shows selectable amounts, associated cashback, recipient name and email fields, and a cart control, all consistent with a gift-card ordering workflow. These observable features do not establish deceptive conduct, a credential request, or an unrelated payment requirement.
